scope_guards: Day, evening, night, LAeq16h and Lden metrics remain distinct.
Round 3 publication date is not the underlying model year.
Ten-metre grid and four-metre receptor height are model assumptions rather than site measurements.
Noise classes do not provide internal levels, façade performance or individual receptor response.
Agglomeration and Important Area geometry are not title or automatic refusal zones.
Environmental-permit noise assessment is distinct from planning assessment.
Strategic maps are not converted into amenity, health, viability or delivery scores.
No score or promotion is written without exact metric, site survey, receptor, proposal and planning evidence.
